description: Extract EXIF metadata from a JPEG: camera make/model, lens, exposure settings, timestamps, orientation and GPS coordinates as decimal lat/lon. The OSINT-standard check for where a photo really came from — parsed in memory, never stored. Use this when an agent needs to camera, settings and GPS from a JPEG. x402 price $0.003/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: media_exif_reader
title: EXIF Metadata Reader
